title: Laboratory sintered (fritted) filters, porosity grading, classification and designation
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12305) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Laboratory sintered (fritted) filters, porosity grading, classification and designation.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of terms relating to glass and glassware

marking_requirements: 5.1 Packing — Each sintered filter shall be suitably packed so as to avoid any shredding, disintegration and breakage during transit. A copy of Appendix D shall be packed with each filter to
5.2 Marking — Each package shall be marked permanently and legibly with the following:
a) Name of the manufacturer or his recognized trade-mark;
b) Designation of porosity grade ( see 3.1 );
d) Lot No. for identification or manufacturing date;
